title: Complete Grammar
goal: Master the complete English grammar system — parts of speech, all twelve tenses, and the advanced structures — always through meaning and real use, never formulas without context.

modules.title: Parts of Speech
modules.description: The nine word classes with their subcategories, uses, examples and the common errors learners make with each.

lessons.title: Nouns: Types and Uses
objectives: Classify common, proper, countable and uncountable nouns
Use nouns in all five sentence patterns
lessons.assessment: Classify 16 of 18 nouns correctly by type

lessons.title: Nouns: Common Errors
objectives: Avoid plural errors like informations and advices
Use articles correctly with common nouns
lessons.assessment: Correct 8 of 10 noun errors in learner-typical sentences

checkpoint.criteria: Classify nouns by type and fix common noun errors

lessons.title: Pronouns: Types and Uses
objectives: Use subject, object and possessive pronouns
Choose reflexive pronouns like myself where needed
lessons.assessment: Use all pronoun types correctly in 12 of 14 items

lessons.title: Pronoun Agreement and Errors
objectives: Match pronouns to their nouns in number and gender
Avoid errors like between you and I
lessons.assessment: Fix 8 of 10 pronoun errors correctly

checkpoint.criteria: Use pronouns accurately and fix agreement errors

lessons.title: Verbs: Types and Uses
objectives: Tell action, linking and helping verbs apart
Match verbs to the sentence patterns they fit
lessons.assessment: Classify 15 of 18 verbs by type and use each in a pattern

lessons.title: Verb Forms and Patterns
objectives: Use base, past, past participle and -ing forms
Learn which verbs take -ing and which take to
lessons.assessment: Supply correct forms for 12 of 14 verbs in context

checkpoint.criteria: Use verb types, forms and basic patterns correctly

lessons.title: Adjectives: Types, Order and Uses
objectives: Use fact and opinion adjectives
Order adjectives correctly: a big old red box
lessons.assessment: Order adjectives correctly in 8 of 10 noun phrases

lessons.title: Adverbs: Types and Position
objectives: Use adverbs of manner, time, frequency and degree
Place adverbs correctly in a sentence
lessons.assessment: Place and choose adverbs correctly in 10 of 12 items

lessons.title: Adjective and Adverb Errors
objectives: Choose good vs well and similar pairs correctly
Fix double-comparative and wrong-form errors
lessons.assessment: Correct 8 of 10 adjective/adverb errors and explain two rules

checkpoint.criteria: Use adjectives and adverbs with correct order, position and form

lessons.title: Prepositions of Place, Time and Movement
objectives: Use in, on, at for time as well as place
Use movement prepositions like to, into, through
lessons.assessment: Choose correct prepositions in 12 of 14 items

lessons.title: Conjunctions: and, but, or, because, so
objectives: Join ideas with coordinating conjunctions
Link causes and results with because and so
lessons.assessment: Combine 8 of 10 sentence pairs with correct conjunctions

lessons.title: Interjections and Parts-of-Speech Review
objectives: Recognise interjections like oh, wow and ouch in speech
Identify all nine word classes in real sentences
lessons.assessment: Label 40 words in a text by part of speech with at least 85 percent accuracy

checkpoint.criteria: Identify and use all nine word classes, including interjections, in context

modules.title: The Tense System and Present Tenses
modules.description: The map of the English tense system, then the four present tenses. Every tense unit covers, across two lessons: meaning and use, structure, affirmative, negative, interrogative and WH forms, verb forms, auxiliary verbs, time expressions, everyday examples, dialogue examples, common mistakes, translation exercises, sentence transformation, and speaking and writing practice.

lessons.title: The English Tense System: An Overview
objectives: Understand time (past, present, future) and aspect (simple, continuous, perfect)
Read the 12-tense map without fear
lessons.assessment: Explain time versus aspect and locate all 12 tenses on the map

checkpoint.criteria: Navigate the 12-tense map: time crossed with aspect

lessons.title: Present Simple: Form and Meaning
objectives: Build affirmative, negative and interrogative forms with do/does
Use the third-person -s correctly
Understand the meaning: habits, facts, schedules
lessons.assessment: Produce all four form types (affirmative, negative, yes/no, WH) with 9 of 10 correct

lessons.title: Present Simple: Use and Practice
objectives: Use time expressions like always, usually, every day
Hear present simple in everyday dialogues
Avoid the he-go error and other common mistakes
lessons.assessment: Complete a daily-routine dialogue and a 5-sentence habit paragraph with at least 80 percent accuracy

checkpoint.criteria: Use present simple for routines and facts with correct forms, time expressions and third-person -s

lessons.title: Present Continuous: Form and Meaning
objectives: Build forms with be + verb-ing
Understand the meaning: happening now, temporary, changing
Distinguish stative verbs rarely used in -ing
lessons.assessment: Produce all four form types correctly in 9 of 10 items

lessons.title: Present Continuous: Use and Practice
objectives: Use now, at the moment and today
Describe pictures and ongoing activities in speech and writing
Choose between present simple and continuous correctly
lessons.assessment: Describe 3 pictures and complete a now-versus-always contrast task with 80 percent accuracy

checkpoint.criteria: Use present continuous for now and temporary situations and contrast it with present simple

lessons.title: Present Perfect: Form and Meaning
objectives: Build forms with have/has + past participle
Understand the meaning: experience, unfinished time, result now
Write regular and learn the key irregular participles
lessons.assessment: Produce correct forms in 9 of 10 items using 8 target participles

lessons.title: Present Perfect: Use and Practice
objectives: Use ever, never, already, yet and just
Tell experiences: I have visited Japan
Avoid mixing present perfect with past time words
lessons.assessment: Complete an experiences interview and 5-sentence experience paragraph with 80 percent accuracy

checkpoint.criteria: Use present perfect for experiences and results with correct participles and time words

lessons.title: Present Perfect Continuous: Form and Meaning
objectives: Build forms with have/has been + verb-ing
Understand the meaning: duration up to now
lessons.assessment: Produce correct forms in 8 of 10 items

lessons.title: Present Perfect Continuous: Use and Practice
objectives: Use for and since with duration
Explain ongoing activities and their visible results
Choose between perfect and perfect continuous
lessons.assessment: Contrast for/since correctly in 9 of 10 items and give a 4-sentence duration account

checkpoint.criteria: Use present perfect continuous for duration with for/since and contrast it with present perfect

modules.title: Past Tenses
modules.description: The four past tenses, each with the full attribute set across two lessons: meaning, forms, auxiliaries, time expressions, dialogues, mistakes, translation, transformation and production practice.

lessons.title: Past Simple: Form and Meaning
objectives: Form regular past with -ed and use the 20 most common irregulars
Build negatives and questions with did
Understand the meaning: finished actions at a finished time
lessons.assessment: Produce all four form types with 9 of 10 correct, using 15 irregular verbs

lessons.title: Past Simple: Use and Practice
objectives: Use yesterday, last week and ago
Narrate a finished event in order
Avoid the did-went double-past error
lessons.assessment: Tell a 6-sentence yesterday story and write it with 80 percent accuracy

checkpoint.criteria: Narrate finished past events with regular and irregular verbs

lessons.title: Past Continuous: Form and Meaning
objectives: Build forms with was/were + verb-ing
Understand the meaning: in progress at a past moment
lessons.assessment: Produce correct forms in 9 of 10 items

lessons.title: Past Continuous: Use and Practice
objectives: Set scenes and describe interrupted actions with when and while
Combine past simple and continuous in stories
Avoid was-were confusion
lessons.assessment: Tell an interrupted-action story of 6 sentences with both tenses used correctly

checkpoint.criteria: Describe past scenes and interruptions with past continuous plus past simple

lessons.title: Past Perfect: Form and Meaning
objectives: Build forms with had + past participle
Understand the meaning: the earlier of two past events
lessons.assessment: Produce correct forms in 8 of 10 items and label event order on timelines

lessons.title: Past Perfect: Use and Practice
objectives: Use before, after and already to sequence events
Narrate cause-and-effect past chains
Use past perfect only where sequence is not already clear
lessons.assessment: Rewrite 5 two-event sentences with past perfect correctly and narrate one chain

checkpoint.criteria: Order past events with past perfect where needed

lessons.title: Past Perfect Continuous: Form and Meaning
objectives: Build forms with had been + verb-ing
Understand the meaning: duration before a past point
lessons.assessment: Produce correct forms in 8 of 10 items

lessons.title: Past Perfect Continuous: Use and Practice
objectives: Explain past causes: I was tired because I had been working
Combine with past simple narration
Choose between past perfect and past perfect continuous
lessons.assessment: Explain 5 past situations using the correct perfect form with 80 percent accuracy

checkpoint.criteria: Use past perfect continuous for duration-before-past causes

modules.title: Future Tenses
modules.description: The four future tenses plus the other ways English talks about the future — each with the full attribute set across form, meaning and production practice.

lessons.title: Future Simple (will): Form and Meaning
objectives: Build forms with will + base verb, negatives and questions
Understand the meaning: predictions, promises, spontaneous decisions
lessons.assessment: Produce all four form types with 9 of 10 correct

lessons.title: Future Simple (will): Use and Practice
objectives: Use tomorrow, next week and in 2030
Make offers and promises in dialogue
Avoid writing I will to go
lessons.assessment: Make 5 predictions and 3 offers in a dialogue with 80 percent accuracy

checkpoint.criteria: Use will for predictions, promises and offers

lessons.title: Future Continuous: Form and Meaning
objectives: Build forms with will be + verb-ing
Understand the meaning: in progress at a future time
lessons.assessment: Produce correct forms in 8 of 10 items

lessons.title: Future Continuous: Use and Practice
objectives: Describe what will be happening at a set future time
Make polite inquiries about someone's plans
lessons.assessment: Describe 5 future-time scenes with correct forms and register

checkpoint.criteria: Describe in-progress future situations with future continuous

lessons.title: Future Perfect: Form and Meaning
objectives: Build forms with will have + past participle
Understand the meaning: completed before a future point
lessons.assessment: Produce correct forms in 8 of 10 items

lessons.title: Future Perfect: Use and Practice
objectives: Use by and by the time with future perfect
Project completed milestones in professional contexts
lessons.assessment: Write a 4-sentence project forecast using by + future perfect correctly

checkpoint.criteria: Express future completion points with future perfect

lessons.title: Future Perfect Continuous: Form and Meaning
objectives: Build forms with will have been + verb-ing
Understand the meaning: duration up to a future point
lessons.assessment: Produce correct forms in 8 of 10 items

lessons.title: Future Perfect Continuous: Use and Practice
objectives: Talk about how long something will have been running
Choose among all four future perfect/continuous forms accurately
lessons.assessment: Select correct future forms in 8 of 10 contrast items

checkpoint.criteria: Use future perfect continuous for future durations and choose among future forms

lessons.title: Going To, Present Continuous and Present Simple for Future
objectives: Use going to for plans and evidence-based predictions
Use present continuous for fixed arrangements
Use present simple for timetables
lessons.assessment: Choose the right future form in 8 of 10 situations and justify two choices

checkpoint.criteria: Select correctly among will, going to, present continuous and present simple futures

modules.title: Additional Grammar
modules.description: The complete remaining grammar system: agreement and modality, voice and reported speech, articles, determiners, quantifiers and comparison, conditionals, relative clauses, gerunds, infinitives, participles, question tags, phrasal verbs, linking words, prepositions, punctuation, capitalisation and common errors.

lessons.title: Subject-Verb Agreement: Advanced Rules
objectives: Agree with tricky subjects like everyone, news and neither
Agree across there is/are and subject phrases
lessons.assessment: Choose correct verb forms for 9 of 10 tricky subjects

lessons.title: Modal Verbs: can, could, may, might, must, should, will, would
objectives: Use core modals for ability, permission, possibility, necessity and advice
Keep the base verb after modals
lessons.assessment: Use all eight core modals correctly in 10 of 12 items

lessons.title: Modal Verbs: Semi-Modals and Perfect Modals
objectives: Use have to, need to, should have and must have
Express past obligation and past deduction
lessons.assessment: Express past advice and deduction correctly in 8 of 10 items

checkpoint.criteria: Use the full modal system including semi-modals and perfect modals

lessons.title: Active and Passive Voice: Forms and Uses
objectives: Form the passive with be + past participle
Understand when passive is the right choice
lessons.assessment: Form passive correctly in 9 of 10 items and justify 2 passive choices

lessons.title: Passive across Tenses and Transformations
objectives: Transform active to passive in the main tenses
Keep or drop the by-agent sensibly
lessons.assessment: Transform 8 of 10 sentences across 5 tenses correctly

lessons.title: Direct and Indirect Speech: Statements and Questions
objectives: Report statements with tense backshift
Report yes/no and WH-questions correctly
lessons.assessment: Report 8 of 10 items with correct backshift and word order

lessons.title: Indirect Speech: Commands, Requests and Time Changes
objectives: Report commands and requests with tell/ask + to
Shift time and place words: now → then, here → there
lessons.assessment: Report commands and shift time words correctly in 8 of 10 items

checkpoint.criteria: Transform voice and speech accurately across tenses and sentence types

lessons.title: Articles: a, an, the — Complete Guide
objectives: Choose between a/an, the and no article
Handle first-mention versus known-reference patterns
lessons.assessment: Choose correct article treatment in 12 of 14 contexts

lessons.title: Determiners
objectives: Use possessive, demonstrative and quantifier determiners together with nouns
Avoid stacking determiners incorrectly
lessons.assessment: Use determiners correctly in 10 of 12 sentences

lessons.title: Quantifiers: some, any, much, many, a few, a little
objectives: Match quantifiers to countable and uncountable nouns
Use some/any in statements, negatives and questions
lessons.assessment: Choose correct quantifiers in 10 of 12 items

lessons.title: Degrees of Comparison
objectives: Form comparatives and superlatives including irregulars
Use as...as, than and the + superlative
lessons.assessment: Form and use all three degrees correctly in 10 of 12 items

checkpoint.criteria: Use articles, determiners, quantifiers and comparison forms accurately

lessons.title: Conditionals: Zero, First and Second
objectives: Distinguish real and unreal conditions
Form the zero, first and second conditionals with correct verb chains
lessons.assessment: Choose and form the right conditional in 9 of 10 items

lessons.title: Conditionals: Third and Mixed
objectives: Form the third conditional for past regrets
Handle mixed conditionals and I wish / if only
lessons.assessment: Express past unreal conditions correctly in 8 of 10 items

lessons.title: Relative Clauses: Defining
objectives: Join sentences with who, which, that, where and when
Choose the correct relative pronoun as subject or object
lessons.assessment: Combine 8 of 10 sentence pairs with defining relative clauses

lessons.title: Relative Clauses: Non-Defining and Reduced
objectives: Punctuate non-defining clauses with commas
Reduce clauses to phrases: the man sitting there
lessons.assessment: Distinguish and punctuate defining versus non-defining clauses in 8 of 10 items

lessons.title: Gerunds and Infinitives: Basics
objectives: Use gerunds after prepositions and enjoy-type verbs
Use infinitives after want-type verbs
lessons.assessment: Choose gerund or infinitive correctly in 10 of 12 items

lessons.title: Gerunds and Infinitives: Verb Patterns
objectives: Handle verbs that change meaning with gerund versus infinitive
Use infinitives of purpose and after adjectives
lessons.assessment: Explain and use 6 meaning-change verbs correctly

lessons.title: Participles: Present and Past
objectives: Use participial adjectives: interesting versus interested
Open sentences with participle phrases correctly
lessons.assessment: Use participle forms correctly in 9 of 10 items including 2 phrase openers

checkpoint.criteria: Build complex sentences with conditionals, relative clauses, gerund/infinitive patterns and participles

lessons.title: Question Tags
objectives: Attach correct question tags: positive statement, negative tag
Use tags for checking and conversation flow
lessons.assessment: Form correct tags for 9 of 10 statements

lessons.title: Phrasal Verbs: Common Combinations
objectives: Learn 15 high-frequency phrasal verbs with real meanings
Use them in natural dialogue
lessons.assessment: Use 12 of 15 target phrasal verbs correctly in context

lessons.title: Phrasal Verbs: Separable, Inseparable and Three-Word
objectives: Place objects correctly with separable phrasals
Use three-word phrasals like look forward to and put up with
lessons.assessment: Order objects correctly in 9 of 10 phrasal sentences

lessons.title: Linking Words and Advanced Conjunctions
objectives: Use however, although, despite and therefore
Signal contrast, cause and result in writing
lessons.assessment: Use 8 linkers correctly across a short opinion paragraph

lessons.title: Prepositions: Advanced Patterns
objectives: Learn verb + preposition and adjective + preposition collocations
Avoid the most common preposition errors
lessons.assessment: Choose correct prepositions in 12 of 14 collocation items

lessons.title: Punctuation
objectives: Use end punctuation, commas, apostrophes and question marks
Punctuate lists and direct speech
lessons.assessment: Correctly punctuate a 10-sentence text with 80 percent accuracy

lessons.title: Capitalisation Rules
objectives: Capitalise names, places, days, months, languages and titles
Fix capitalisation in real texts
lessons.assessment: Fix 10 of 12 capitalisation errors

lessons.title: Common Grammatical Errors
objectives: Diagnose the 15 most frequent learner errors
Self-edit written work using a checklist
lessons.assessment: Identify and correct 12 of 15 planted errors in a text

checkpoint.criteria: Apply mechanics, phrasal verbs and error-awareness in editing tasks

exitAssessment.title: Complete Grammar Exit Test
exitAssessment.criteria: Parts of speech analysis; all 12 tenses in form and use (transformation, error correction, translation); modal system; passive and reported speech transformations; articles, quantifiers and comparison; conditionals and relative clauses; gerund/infinitive patterns; punctuation and capitalisation; error diagnosis. Meaning-first: every item asks what the sentence communicates, not only its form.
